scripts.build: bun run compile:codestack-shared && turbo run build
scripts.build:codestack-web: bun run compile:codestack-shared && bun run --filter=codestack-web vscode:prepublish
scripts.build:codestack-remote: bun run compile:codestack-shared && bun run --filter=codestack-remote-ssh vscode:prepublish
scripts.hot-reload:codestack-web: bun run compile:codestack-shared && bun run build:codestack-web && cp -R ./apps/codestack-web /ide/extensions/codestack-web
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && rimraf apps/*/out packages/*/out packages/*/lib
